questions.question: Which organizations has Netflix partnered with to develop the next generation of creative-technology talent in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IICT and FICCI.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Netflix has partnered with the Indian Institute of Creative Technology (IICT) and FICCI to develop the next generation of creative-technology talent in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The partnership was formalized through a memorandum of understanding (MoU) exchanged at the 25th edition of FICCI Frames.**
 
• **The Netflix fund for creative equity will offer scholarships to students identified in collaboration with IICT.**
 
• **The goal of the partnership is to develop creative-technology talent in India for the next generation of professionals.**
 
• **Netflix aims to contribute to the growth of the Indian creative-tech sector through this initiative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IICT__

 __
 
• The Indian Institute of Creative Technology (IICT) specializes in creative arts and technology education.
 
 
 
• FICCI Frames__
 __
 
• An annual event organized by the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI), focusing on media, entertainment, and creative industries.
 
 
 
• Netflix Fund for Creative Equity__
 
 
• A fund launched by Netflix to support and provide opportunities for underrepresented groups in the entertainment industry, including scholarships and grants.

questions.question: How many MoUs were signed between India and Mongolia following the bilateral talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Mongolian President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa in October 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and Mongolia signed **10 MoUs** following bilateral talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Mongolian President Khurelsukh Ukhnaa in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The MoUs cover areas such as **humanitarian aid, heritage restoration, immigration, geology, mineral resources, cooperatives, and digital solutions.**
 
• On this occasion, both leaders released commemorative stamps marking the **70th anniversary of India-Mongolia bilateral relations**.
 
• India will provide **free e-visas** to Mongolian citizens and sponsor the annual visit of young cultural ambassadors from Mongolia.
 
• The MoUs include significant agreements on the **oil refinery project** and digital cooperation between the two nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Strategic Partnership**__: The joint statement aims to strengthen the strategic partnership between India and Mongolia, focusing on global issues and bilateral cooperation.
 
• __**Oil Refinery Project**__: Built with India’s **1.7 billion US dollars line of credit**, this project will boost Mongolia’s energy security.
 
• __**Digital Cooperation MoU**__: A key agreement focused on enhancing collaboration in the field of digital technologies between the two countries.
 
• __**Mongolian Air Carrier**__: A Mongolian airline is preparing to operate charter flights to **Amritsar and New Delhi**, strengthening bilateral tourism and business links.

questions.question: Which state signed MoUs worth ₹38,750 crore at the World Economic Forum in Davos?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra signed MoUs worth ₹38,750 crore at the World Economic Forum in Davos.**
 
• The agreements include investments in defense, steel, electric vehicles (EVs), and metals.
 
• Key investors include Kalyani Group, Reliance Infrastructure, and Balasore Alloys.
 
• The investments are projected to create nearly 10,000 jobs in Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra signed MoUs worth ₹38,750 crore during the World Economic Forum in Davos.**
 
• The Kalyani Group will invest ₹5,250 crore in defense, steel, and EVs, creating 4,000 jobs.
 
• Reliance Infrastructure committed ₹16,500 crore for defense, generating 2,450 jobs.
 
• Balasore Alloys pledged ₹17,000 crore for steel and metals, leading to 3,200 job opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Economic Forum (WEF)__

 __
 
• An international organization for public-private cooperation, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• The annual meeting in Davos brings together global leaders, policymakers, and business executives to discuss economic and social challenges.
 
 
 
• Kalyani Group__
 __
 
• A prominent Indian conglomerate with operations in defense, engineering, and steel.
 
• The group’s investment focuses on modernizing defense production and promoting sustainability in steel and EV manufacturing.
 
 
 
• Balasore Alloys__
 
 
• A key player in the Indian steel and alloys sector.
 
• Their investment aims to enhance India’s steel production capacity and generate employment.

questions.question: Which state government in India signed an MoU with Iceland for geothermal energy development in January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Uttarakhand government signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Iceland’s Verkis Consulting Engineers for the exploration and development of geothermal energy in the state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttarakhand identified 40 geothermal sites across the state as part of its initiative to achieve carbon neutrality by 2070.**
 
• The Icelandic government will cover the costs for the feasibility study of geothermal energy in Uttarakhand.
 
• The Geological Survey of India and Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology conducted assessments identifying geothermal potential in the state.
 
• The MoU signing took place in the presence of Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami and Iceland’s Ambassador to India, Dr. Benedikt Hoskuldsson.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Geothermal Energy__

 __
 
• Renewable energy derived from the heat stored beneath the Earth's surface.
 
• Used for electricity generation, direct heating, and geothermal heat pumps for residential and commercial purposes.
 
 
 
• Verkis Consulting Engineers__
 __
 
• An Icelandic firm with global expertise in geothermal energy exploration and development.
 
• Will play a key role in implementing geothermal projects in Uttarakhand.
 
 
 
• India’s Renewable Energy Goals__
 
 
• Committed to achieving carbon neutrality by 2070.
 
• Encouraging innovative energy solutions like geothermal energy to support sustainable development.

questions.question: With which technology company has the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) partnered to launch the ‘AI Careers for Women’ initiative?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Microsoft.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) has partnered with Microsoft to launch the ‘AI Careers for Women’ initiative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The collaboration aims to bridge the gender gap in AI and digital skills by providing specialized training for women in Tier-II and Tier-III towns.
 
• Microsoft will provide a 240-hour training curriculum aligned with industry standards in partnership with MSDE and other academic institutions.
 
• The initiative will include the establishment of 30 Centers of Excellence at women’s colleges to offer hands-on AI training and career guidance.
 
• The goal is to empower 20,000 young women and create career pathways in AI, especially in rural India, for economic opportunities and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Google__

 __
 
• Has also been involved in various skilling initiatives but was not a partner in this specific program with MSDE.
 
 
 
• IBM__
 __
 
• Active in AI education and research but is not a partner in the ‘AI Careers for Women’ initiative.
 
 
 
• Oracle__
 
 
• Provides cloud computing and AI services, but has not partnered with MSDE in this particular program.

questions.question: ̌The Defence Ministry recently signed an MoU with which organisation to improve pension, healthcare, resettlement, and welfare services for veterans and their dependents?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Quality Council of India (QCI).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Defence Ministry signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Quality Council of India (QCI) in New Delhi to strengthen services for over 63 lakh veterans and their families.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **QCI will support the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DESW) through digital evaluations and impact assessments.**
 
• **It will provide evidence-based policy recommendations to improve service delivery.**
 
• **DESW will facilitate data access and coordination with State Governments, Zila Sainik Boards, Armed Forces HQ, and empanelled hospitals.**
 
• **The initiative will expand healthcare delivery, re-employment, and entrepreneurship opportunities for veterans.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Quality Council of India (QCI)__

 __
 
• Established in 1997 as an autonomous body.
 
• Promotes quality standards across sectors including industry, healthcare, education, and governance.
 
 
 
• Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DESW)__
 __
 
• Works under the Ministry of Defence.
 
• Responsible for policies and schemes for resettlement, pension, healthcare, and welfare of veterans and dependents.
 
 
 
• Significance of the MoU__
 
 
• Strengthens institutional frameworks of State and District Sainik Boards.
 
• Ensures evidence-based decision-making to improve veteran services.

questions.question: Which American multinational software corporation has signed an MoU with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) to enhance India’s “design and make” competency through ITIs and NSTIs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Autodesk Inc.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), through the Directorate General of Training (DGT), signed an MoU with Autodesk Inc. on 6 November 2025 to upgrade digital design and manufacturing skills across India’s vocational training network.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The MoU aims to strengthen the “design and make” competency of India’s vocational workforce by integrating Autodesk’s advanced digital tools and curricula into ITIs and NSTIs.
 
• India’s Directorate General of Training (DGT) oversees over 14,500 Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and 33 National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) that will benefit from this collaboration.
 
• Autodesk will co-create project-based and hands-on digital training modules, including exposure to AI-driven design and digital prototyping tools.
 
• The initiative ensures India’s vocational graduates are industry-ready, particularly for sectors like architecture, construction, engineering, and manufacturing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Autodesk Inc.**__

 __
 
• Founded: 1982
 
• Headquarters: San Francisco, USA
 
• Founder: John Walker
 
• Known for: AutoCAD, Revit, and Fusion 360 software suites used in design, architecture, and manufacturing.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)**__
 __
 
• Established: 2014
 
• Objective: To coordinate all skill development efforts across the country.
 
• Key Training Arm: Directorate General of Training (DGT).
 
 
 
• **India’s Vocational Training Infrastructure**__
 __
 
• Over 14,500 ITIs and 33 NSTIs provide technical and vocational education.
 
• These institutions cater to millions of youth annually, preparing them for industrial and service sector employment.
 
 
 
• **Focus Areas of Collaboration**__
 
 
• Grassroots innovation and AI-enhanced design skills
 
• Trainer capacity building and digital curriculum integration
 
• Creating an innovation-ready workforce aligned with global best practices.

questions.question: Which two countries signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) on Mutual Submarine Search and Rescue Support and Cooperation in November 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Vietnam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and Vietnam signed a significant **Memorandum of Agreement (MoA)** on **Mutual Submarine Search and Rescue Support and Cooperation** during the **15th India–Vietnam Defence Policy Dialogue** in Hanoi, Vietnam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The MoA aims to provide mutual support in case of submarine-related emergencies, ensuring prompt assistance with **search and rescue operations** and the deployment of personnel, equipment, and technical expertise.
 
• Additionally, a **Letter of Intent (LoI)** was signed to foster collaboration in the **defence manufacturing sector**, including **technology sharing** and potential joint development of systems.
 
• This agreement strengthens the **India–Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership** and aligns with India’s **Act East Policy** and Vietnam’s increasing maritime role.
 
• The MoA is seen as a strategic move to enhance **maritime security** and interoperability in the **Indo-Pacific region**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India-Vietnam Defence Cooperation**__

 __
 
• This MoA reflects a growing defence partnership, particularly in **maritime security** and **submarine rescue operations**.
 
• The agreement enhances bilateral relations, fostering mutual trust and readiness to address maritime threats.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the MoA**__
 __
 
• The MoA allows India and Vietnam to **coordinate search and rescue operations** in case of submarine distress, improving regional undersea safety.
 
• The collaboration could also facilitate joint **training and technology exchanges** in submarine operations and naval architecture.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Impact on the Indo-Pacific**__
 __
 
• The MoA supports broader regional stability in the **Indo-Pacific**, particularly concerning submarine operations and safety in busy maritime zones.
 
• Both nations have growing concerns about maritime security, making this partnership crucial for ensuring peace and stability in the region.
 
 
 
• **Key Static Facts**__
 
 
• Event: 15th India–Vietnam Defence Policy Dialogue
 
• Date: November 2025
 
• Location: Hanoi, Vietnam
 
• Indian Representative: Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh
 
• Vietnam Representative: Deputy Defence Minister Sr Lt Gen Hoang Xuan Chien
 
• Agreements: MoA on Mutual Submarine Search and Rescue Support, LoI on Defence Industry Collaboration
